topic: Asset import issues for OOH locations
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on technical difficulties related to importing assets into the system. A specific asset file was noted to be problematic, causing issues for multiple users (including someone who usually handles it). The user confirmed that while they managed to upload an asset file for 'Oshien Denmark' after several attempts and manual sorting/manipulation of the file structure, this process is not straightforward. They also mentioned a separate successful upload for 'DSD Brazil' regarding assets.
decisions: The problematic asset import issue will be reviewed.
action_items: Someone needs to provide the necessary asset files for review.
